mapper.select: INSERT INTO spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error ( id, job_id, instance_id, runtime_id, error_fingerprint, error_code, error_message, status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, last_logged_at, occurrence_count, suppressed_count, last_context, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{error.id}, #{error.jobId}, #{error.instanceId}, #{error.runtimeId}, #{error.errorFingerprint}, #{error.errorCode}, #{error.errorMessage}, 'OPEN', #{error.firstSeenAt}, #{error.lastSeenAt}, #{error.lastLoggedAt}, 1, 0, #{error.lastContext, typeHandler=com.devops00.spectra.common.mybatis.PgJsonbTypeHandler}, #{error.createdAt}, #{error.updatedAt}, #{error.version} ) ON CONFLICT (job_id, instance_id, error_fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET runtime_id = EXCLUDED.runtime_id, error_code = EXCLUDED.error_code, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, last_logged_at = CASE WHEN spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.last_logged_at IS NULL OR spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.last_logged_at <= EXCLUDED.last_seen_at - (#{logIntervalMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') THEN EXCLUDED.last_logged_at ELSE spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.last_logged_at END, occurrence_count = spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.occurrence_count + 1, suppressed_count = CASE WHEN spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.last_logged_at IS NULL OR spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.last_logged_at <= EXCLUDED.last_seen_at - (#{logIntervalMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') THEN spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.suppressed_count ELSE spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.suppressed_count + 1 END, last_context = EXCLUDED.last_context, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = spectra_core.scheduler_loop_error.version + 1 RETURNING *
